case_order: case_id=(process_index*2+offset)%6, offset0..5; V indexed by case_id/2, pattern by case_id%2

allocation_and_reset_semantics.timed_scope: vector resize, exact copied id/logit/p loop and array descriptor assignment
allocation_and_reset_semantics.allocation: first invocation begins with empty vector; first resize includes allocator and first touch; steady invocations reuse same size/data/capacity and allocate nothing
allocation_and_reset_semantics.quality: Full every-element exact id/logit bits/p=+0 and view fields checked after every timed call; checks are outside timer and warm candidate output.
allocation_and_reset_semantics.input_reset: same immutable logits, no reset needed; wrapper overwrites every candidate field and view

allocation_and_reset_semantics.implementation: GetProcAddress-resolved original llama.dll llama_sampler_apply with llama_sampler_init_top_k(1)
allocation_and_reset_semantics.timed_scope: one original exported apply call only; input has sorted=false, selected=-1,size=V
allocation_and_reset_semantics.allocation: DLL load and sampler init occur once per process outside all stage windows. Work/baseline buffers allocate before stage; top-k sampler reused as source-proven stateless filter.
allocation_and_reset_semantics.input_reset: memcpy baseline V*12 bytes and reset view fields before EVERY invocation; reset excluded from timer, intentionally warms work buffer
allocation_and_reset_semantics.quality: Exact unique argmax id and float bits, p=0,size=1,sorted=true,selected=-1,unchanged backing pointer checked outside clock. Filter output is not a committed sampled token.

clock_policy.observer_adjustment: record independently; do not subtract noisy observer samples or add stage walls
clock_policy.timed_windows: sequential, disjoint, non-nested; no combined candidate+topk stage is reported
